body_markdown:
*Fundraise Insider tracks newly funded startups each week and delivers verified[sales leads](https://fundraiseinsider.com/) of C-suite contacts straight to your inbox, so you reach the right people while the funding is still fresh.[See pricing.](https://fundraiseinsider.com/pricing)*


Standard Metrics has raised $20 million in[Series B](https://fundraiseinsider.com/blog/series-b-startups/) funding led by 8VC, with Salesforce Ventures, Spark Capital, January Capital, First Trust Capital Partners, Socii Capital, Kindergarten Ventures, Calm Ventures and Gaingels among the other participants.


The company works from[San Francisco](https://fundraiseinsider.com/blog/recently-funded-startups-san-francisco/) , California, and sells an AI driven portfolio management platform to the firms that do the investing rather than to the companies they back.


It is a market with a well known operational headache. Portfolio data arrives from hundreds of companies in whatever format each founder happens to use, then has to be reconciled by hand before anyone can report on it. Standard Metrics automates the ingestion, parses documents with AI, and puts an AI Analyst on the platform itself, alongside MCP interoperability and analysis and reporting tools built for portfolio reviews, valuations, LP reporting and diligence.


Scale gives a sense of how entrenched the product has become. It supports more than 10,000 portfolio companies and 150 firms managing over $400 billion in assets, which is a substantial share of the[venture capital and private equity](https://fundraiseinsider.com/blog/venture-capital-private-equity-startups/) market by any measure.


John Melas-Kyriazi is chief executive. The new capital deepens the AI work, grows the team, and pushes the platform toward more private market investors and their portfolio companies.


Vendors selling into investment firms and financial technology companies can reach decision makers through[fintech lead generation](https://fundraiseinsider.com/fintech-lead-generation/) built around newly funded rounds.
